name: Statefox Properties API
description:
Statefox API for querying indexed properties and property snapshots.

**Authentication:** This API uses a Bearer Token. Include it in the header:
'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TOKEN>'.
To request/renew a token, contact **support@statefox.com**.
